messages.subject: data table pagination and options
parts:
Is there a quick fix to put the pagination buttons above the table part of the data table.

reason: I am listing strings in the data table... when the strings wrap, the vertical length of the datatable necessarily increases, moving the paginations buttons. I could use bScrollable, but that comes off a bit awkward in my application. I'd like to just put the pagination buttons above the table.

Extra credit: I've been searching the datatable options for how to remove the margin above the table (I have bFilter and bLengthChange turned off, so the UI elements are not their, but the space they occupied is still occupied by empty margin).

Shiny is such a great tool. Having used it so much now, it's tough to imagine not having shiny to work with. Thanks!

I figured out all of the options parts to this.

The extra margin space - that was occupied by the elements I removed using datatable options - remains and takes up the same space. If there is an easy way to remove this "margin", that would be helpful info.

- Dan
